title: What's new in Page Scripting  (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: New capabilities - multiple selection and validation

features.name: Page scripting tool
features.description: A tool that allows customers and consultants to record and replay user actions directly in the web client for testing and user acceptance testing purposes.
features.status_evidence_quote: in this release, we are now moving the page scripting from preview into making it generally available

features.name: Page scripting localization
features.description: Full localization of page scripting tool with all user-facing strings translated including steps, error messages, and tooltips.

features.name: Multiple selection in grids
features.description: Support for recording the selection of multiple rows in a list to enable bulk action recording and replay.

features.name: Message and error dialogue validation
features.description: Ability to validate the text shown in messages or error dialogues during recordings, turning recordings into real assertions rather than just sequences of clicks.

features.name: Agent-generated page scripts
features.description: Agents can be used to generate page scripting scripts and run them automatically.

quotes.text: the page scripting tool allows customers and consultants to record and replay user actions directly in the web client
quotes.why_it_matters: Defines the core purpose and user base of the page scripting tool.

quotes.text: empowering customers and consultants to create tests in a more agile, quicker, and cost-effective way
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the business value proposition - enabling non-developers to create tests faster and cheaper.

quotes.text: in this release, we are now moving the page scripting from preview into making it generally available
quotes.why_it_matters: Announces the status change from preview to general availability.

quotes.text: it's now fully localized. Every user-facing string is translated, all steps, error messages, tooltips
quotes.why_it_matters: Specifies the localization scope as a prerequisite for general availability.

quotes.text: we have support for multiple selection in grids, so that you can record selecting several rows in a list and run bulk actions
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes a new capability for recording grid selections and bulk operations.

quotes.text: you can now validate the text shown in a message or in an error dialogue to actually assess when that happens
quotes.why_it_matters: Introduces the validation feature that elevates recordings from clicks to assertions.

quotes.text: that turns the recording into actually a real assertion, not just a sequence of clicks
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that message validation creates proper test assertions.

disclaimers.text: we launched it in in preview back then
